name: swek-engine
title: SweK Engine
description: Control your SweK Engine from Raycast: status, peers, panels, toasts. Points at the bridge on localhost:8787 by default; set a LAN or Cloudflare tunnel URL in preferences to drive a remote box.
author: helga

commands.name: engine-status
commands.title: Engine Status
commands.subtitle: SweK Engine
commands.description: Bridge health, version, tunnel, peers, KPop listener, Ollama.

commands.name: open-panel
commands.title: Open Engine Panel
commands.subtitle: SweK Engine
commands.description: Jump to any engine page (server, control, hosting, Raycast LLM, Pip-Boy...).

commands.name: send-toast
commands.title: Send Toast
commands.subtitle: SweK Engine
commands.description: Fire a KPop toast on the engine box through /kpop/toast.

preferences.name: bridgeUrl
preferences.title: Bridge URL
preferences.description: SweK ai-bridge base URL. Local box: http://127.0.0.1:8787 - a LAN peer: http://192.168.x.x:8787 - or your Cloudflare tunnel https URL.
